name: zentrola
description: Generate images, query Zentrola account information, and manage ordinary members with an authorized Key.

interface.shortDescription: Generate images and view Zentrola account information.
interface.longDescription: Reuse the Zentrola endpoint and Access Key already configured for the current client to generate PNG images, query account information, and manage ordinary members when the Key has permission.
defaultPrompt: Use $zentrola:imagegen to generate a PNG image from my description.
Use $zentrola:usage to query my current-month Zentrola token usage.
Use $zentrola:member-management to create an ordinary member and their first Key.
Use $zentrola:provider to show my current Zentrola service provider.
